method: Post-draft review against code, exact-data fits, curvature checks, test logs, and independent mathematical review
score_reason: Concrete findings, working code, and explicit limits; no inflated completion claim.
evidence_none_reason: Concrete results and explicit limits throughout; no stylistic repair required.
science_gate_reason: Prior curvature independently cross-checked; posterior SDs distinguished from coverage.
facts_gate_reason: Technical counts and committed-source check verified against retained logs; private fit values excluded.
references_gate_reason: Issue number and file paths verified; no literature citations.
calibration_status: Protocol calibration examples seen; no benchmark comparison performed
